## Test-backed fixes the live legs surfaced

- `hh-mcp-lab`: `submit_input`'s `content` member now lowers to the canonical `input` (regression test `l46a_submit_input_lowers_content`).
- `hh acp`: the `--capability` flag is parsed (`hh-cli/src/lab.rs`) — the open-time approval-gated capability the permission round-trip needs.
- `hh-control/src/replay.rs`: `extract_recorded` mints a `HumanInput::Approval` replay cue only for *effect-tied* human `security.permission.decided` rows — a boundary-level grant (no `effect_id`) is decided out of loop through `permission_decision`; re-feeding it minted a spurious `propose` and skewed the shared allocator (`expected mc-21, got mc-13` → `replay_diverged`). New test `boundary_level_human_decided_mints_no_approval_cue` fails if the gate is removed.
- ACP wire conformance for the official SDK's closed schema: durable `security.permission.pending` records the declared offer under `request.options`; the wire renders spec-shaped `{optionId,name,kind}` options + `toolCallId` on `session/request_permission`.
- `scripts/live-capstone-acp.mjs`: a bounded 500 ms settle window closes the pty echo race (a frame landing before `stty -echo` applies echoes to the SDK's duplex → phantom `initialize` → `-32601`); `extMethod` called with bare member names (it prepends `_` itself) so `_hh/account` + `_hh/ledger/read` are exercised on the official arm.
- `scripts/live-capstone.sh`: the sweep loop rides `</dev/null` — leg runners' stdin was eating the leg list (sweep ran only the first leg).
- `replay{driver_mode}` answers a `diverged{at_seq,expected,got}` member when the deterministic driver diverges.
